Figure-ready versions of results from the fitting documents. Nothing is fitted here: the fits are read from `fits/`,
so run `13_main.Rmd` (main model), `14_abrahamic.Rmd` (+ Abrahamic) and `15_texts.Rmd` (+ texts) first.

Run from inside `modeling/`. Figures are saved in `fig/paper/`.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(posterior)

theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 10))
fig_dir <- "fig/paper"
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

model_files <- c(main = "main_region_time", texts = "texts", abrahamic = "abrahamic")  # order in the figures
model_labels <- c(main = "main model (groups)", texts = "+ texts", abrahamic = "+ Abrahamic")
model_colors <- c(main = "#2b2a28", texts = "#2a78d6", abrahamic = "#8a63d2")
```

# Average slopes

Average of the four region slopes per draw (log-odds per 1,000 years), for each model and question.

```{r slopes, message = FALSE}
fit_path <- function(model, question) {
  set <- if_else(question %in% questions$question[questions$domain == "parent"], "parent", "conditional")
  sprintf("fits/%s_%s_%s.rds", model_files[[model]], set, question)
}

average_slope <- function(path) {
  draws <- as_draws_df(readRDS(path), variable = "^b_region.*:time$", regex = TRUE) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    select(starts_with("b_"))
  value <- rowMeans(draws)
  tibble(mean = mean(value), lower = quantile(value, 0.025), upper = quantile(value, 0.975),
         p_positive = mean(value > 0))
}

slopes <- crossing(model = names(model_files), question = questions$question) |>
  mutate(est = map2(model, question, ~ average_slope(fit_path(.x, .y)))) |>
  unnest(est) |>
  left_join(questions, by = "question")

slopes |>
  select(model, question, mean, lower, upper, p_positive) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2))) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = c(mean, p_positive)) |>
  select(-lower, -upper) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

# Figure 2: average slopes, three models

```{r fig2, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 10}
# filled points: 95% sure of the direction (P(slope > 0) >= 0.95 or <= 0.05); open otherwise
fig2_data <- slopes |>
  mutate(
    model = factor(model, levels = rev(names(model_files))),  # main on top within each question, then texts
    label = factor(label, levels = rev(questions$label)),
    sure = p_positive >= 0.95 | p_positive <= 0.05
  )
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.72)

fig2 <- ggplot(fig2_data, aes(mean, label, colour = model, group = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), position = dodge, linewidth = 0.55) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = if_else(sure, model, NA)), shape = 21, size = 1.7, stroke = 0.7, position = dodge) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = model_colors, labels = model_labels, breaks = names(model_files), name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = model_colors, na.value = "white", guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-2, 2, 1)) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = model_colors, size = 2.6, linewidth = 1))) +
  labs(x = "Average time slope (log-odds per 1,000 years)", y = NULL) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.key.width = unit(26, "pt"),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(6, "pt"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = 9),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(4, "pt")
  )
fig2
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "fig2_slopes.jpg"), fig2, width = 7, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```
